parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is a switch handle of the faucet made of stainless steel, used to control water flow or temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn the water on or off and adjust the temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt depending on the faucet design to regulate water flow.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is another switch handle of the faucet made of stainless steel, typically used for controlling hot or cold water separately.
parts.Functional_description: It controls one side of the water supply, either hot or cold, allowing temperature mixing.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt to adjust the water flow from one side.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet made of stainless steel, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the mixed water from the faucet body to the sink area.
parts.Movement_description: It is usually fixed but may swivel in some designs to direct water flow.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is a base frame part of the faucet made of stainless steel, providing structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It secures the faucet to the sink or countertop and stabilizes the spout and switches.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a mounting surface.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is another frame component of the faucet made of stainless steel, supporting one of the switches.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the switch in place and connects it to the internal valve mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the central frame base of the faucet made of stainless steel, supporting the spout.
parts.Functional_description: It anchors the spout to the sink and connects it to the water supply lines.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and provides a stable base for the spout.
